summary: Support for other APIs can be added by dropping a custom plugin into the httpapi_plugins directory. See the httpapi developer guide.
questions: How do I add support for a new device HTTP API?
Where do custom httpapi plugins go?

answer_card.title: Adding an httpapi plugin
answer_card.answer_md: Put a custom plugin in the `httpapi_plugins` directory. See the httpapi plugin developer guide for details.
